name: Short Code
summary: Early interpreted algebraic coding system for BINAC/UNIVAC I in which mathematical expressions were written as pairs of two-character codes; often cited as the first high-level language actually used on an electronic computer.

level_notes.0: No implementation survives; the interpreter existed only on BINAC/UNIVAC I.
level_notes.1: No published specification survives online; descriptions come from UNIVAC documentation summaries and later histories.
